design_status: prospectively frozen before any model recovery experiment; observed policy approved by root
scope: Conditional whole finite-D observation-frame Gaussian intensity inverse, four unknown geometry parameters and two shared bounded levels; no physical-camera, global-search or automatic-CAD acceptance.

observation_contract.pixels: Unique integer observation-frame pixel indices; geometric centres are indices+0.5. Homography maps supplied plane geometry into this same observation field.
observation_contract.covariance: Supplied constant SPD covariance in observation-coordinate squared pixels; not inferred optical covariance from a rectified summary.
observation_contract.metric: Fixed identity residual transform in primary reconstruction cases; supplemental supplied projections only in derivative/rank controls.
observation_contract.material: Finite disk intersect one supplied-normal half-plane; constant inside/background unless a diagnostic source explicitly differs.
observation_contract.input_origin: Independent conic vertical-slice area integration; no production forward means generate observations.

seed_and_roi.policy: Only observed field and supplied H, normal, polarity, covariance and threshold; no truth-derived bounds or pixel choices.
seed_and_roi.detector: Full fixed64x64 field at geometric pixel centres i+.5; independent positive-area oracle, order24.
seed_and_roi.background: Median of all outermost border pixels, each counted once.
seed_and_roi.material: 99.8th percentile for declared bright material;0.2th percentile for declared dark material.
seed_and_roi.crossings: All horizontal/vertical adjacent-centre strict threshold brackets, linearly interpolated; exact threshold nodes retained once; inverse-H mapped.
seed_and_roi.circle_seed: Centered algebraic circle least squares on contour points with supplied n projection<=65th percentile; at least6points and rank2. Radius clipped to [.05,4*observed_extent] only for initializer; record unclipped value.
seed_and_roi.chord_seed: 97th percentile supplied n projection of all observed crossing points; f=(support−n·Cseed)/Rseed, clipped to[-.9,.9].
seed_and_roi.geometry_bounds: centre each Cseed±max(.5*Rseed,3*blur_plane); R in[max(.05,.25*Rseed),max(2*Rseed,observed_extent)]; f in[max(-.98,fseed−.45),min(.98,fseed+.45)]. blur_plane is max spectral norm(DHinv at observed contour bbox corners) times supplied sigma_max. No truth widening.
seed_and_roi.roi: Observed threshold-mask bbox expanded by ceil(3*sigma_max) observation pixels, clipped to sensor.
seed_and_roi.strata: Edge .15<u<.85 sorted by angle around observed mask centroid, then radius,row,column; high u>=.9 and low u<=.1 sorted row,column. Uniform rounded index spacing selects32edge+12high+12low; every fourth goes heldout.
seed_and_roi.counts: Train24edge+8high+8low; heldout8edge+4high+4low, unique and disjoint. Missing contrast, contour, finite circle seed or enough stratum pixels returns explicit ineligible outcome.
seed_and_roi.diagnostic_restrictions: cropped-chord restricts training x<=30 AFTER full observed seed; contour-only keeps only training edge stratum AFTER full observed seed; heldouts remain fixed.
seed_and_roi.background_material_semantics: Observed high/low strata are numerical sampling rules, not a proof of physically flat plateaus.
seed_and_roi.coordinate_contract: All crossing coordinates already geometric pixel centres; no extra shift to or from main traced rings.

oracle.normalization: Unit-mass Gaussian point response; positive conditional-area integral, not Green flux.

matched_targets.meaning: Predeclared digital numerical recovery targets only. All incomplete/failed matched cases retained and cause study target failure; no target relaxation.

diagnostic_policy: Retain every fitted value, residual, flags, wrong-model geometry error and execution outcome. No requirement every mismatch is rejected and no adverse result relabeled as intrinsic converged bias when work-limited.

independent_checks.shape_derivative: Positive-area central finite differences at two parameter steps, compared with production shape Jacobian; arc normal velocities(u_x,u_y,1,0), chord(n_x,n_y,f,R), factorabs(detDH).
independent_checks.variable_projection: Fixed-active-face GP Jacobian versus finite differences of independent two-level profiled residual, including interior and active brightness cases.
independent_checks.information_rank: Rank uses projected MEAN derivatives only; rank ceiling<=rank(T)-rank(free level design). Residual-dependent GP term is not Fisher information.
independent_checks.work: Bounded full grid/derivative/forward work; no assertion of exhaustive global minima.

derivative_targets.meaning: Two-step finite difference checks, numerical not certified.

cli_contract: Required --output fresh .json before production imports or analysis; --help/missing/existing/dangling-symlink refusals perform no analysis. Strict JSON saved and stdout identical. Every planned row retained after per-row errors; source before/after bound.
